audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 read 'Skill' while every matching why says you out-poke, out-trade and near-delete him, and breakdown.mid says 'This is your lane.' Row 6 reads Neeko while whys[6] and the 'late' text both say Volibear reclaims it at 2+ items.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Skill]; win rate 78.95% over 19 games; difficulty is already rated 4/10 favoured. The current chart contradicts its own prose in both directions.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Neeko, row 6 to Skill, row 0 stays Neeko — one atomic pair-matched group in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item Liandry's/Blackfire, and his Lvl 6+ window. Spike 4's content was wrong (see point 4) but the timing structure is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Sky Splitter (E) a stun and 'his only point-and-click lock-on', and credits his R with a shield. All three are wrong.
audit.why: Riot: E 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius' — a 1200-range ground-targeted skillshot with slow and a self-shield, no stun and not point-and-click. The stun and the gap-close are both Thundering Smash (Q), 300 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, and it is also an auto-attack reset. R (Stormbringer) grants bonus Health, not a shield.
audit.corrected: Q is the stun and the gap-close; E is a slow plus self-shield; dodge the Q wind-up, not an imaginary E stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers; the reader is told to wait for 'its downtime' without ever learning how long that is.
audit.why: Thundering Smash 12s at rank 1, Sky Splitter a flat 16s, Frenzied Maul a flat 5s, Stormbringer 160/135/110s. The 12s Q window is the one that governs your step-ups.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is mentioned only in report[8]; the content layer describes his W healing three times without ever naming Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul heals on the recast against a marked target on a flat 5s cooldown and applies on-hit effects, so his sustain scales with attack speed via the passive — armour alone reads the trade wrong.

edits.before: His Stormbringer (R) + E stun gap-close is his only kill window — dodge the E hand and Voli has no follow-up.
edits.after: Thundering Smash (Q) is his stun and his gap-close, down 12s at rank 1 — dodge it and Voli has no follow-up.

edits.before: Land his E (Sky Splitter) stun to lock you for a Q-dash + W-bite all-in on your squishy body
edits.after: Land Thundering Smash (Q) to stun you at 300 range for a Frenzied Maul all-in on your squishy body

edits.before: You out-poke a pre-item Voli all lane — his W heal can't keep pace with repeated Blooming Burst hits.
edits.after: You out-poke pre-item Voli — Frenzied Maul heals on its recast, so bring anti-heal for the long trades.

edits.before: Level 1 you have no combo and only a single-target Q, so don't contest him — he wants an early bite-and-Q-dash brawl you can't win yet. Just farm with the tip of Blooming Burst and respect that his W heals chunk back. Once you hit Level 3 with Q + E you get your first real window: he has no gap-closer until his Q is leveled, so when he walks up to CS, lead with Tangle-Barbs to root him and unload a double-bloom Q. Dodge nothing here except his E (Sky Splitter) — it's his only point-and-click lock-on, and without it he can't reach you.
edits.after: Level 1 you have no combo and only a single-target Q, so don't contest him — he wants an early bite-and-Q-dash brawl you can't win yet. Just farm with the tip of Blooming Burst and respect that his W heals chunk back. Once you hit Level 3 with Q + E you get your first real window: Thundering Smash (Q) is his only gap-close, so when he walks up to CS, lead with Tangle-Barbs to root him and unload a double-bloom Q. Sky Splitter (E) is a 1200-range bolt that slows and shields him — the stun you dodge is the Q wind-up.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'His Stormbringer' in spikes[3] as a probable wrong name — that is a FALSE POSITIVE, Stormbringer is Volibear's real R. The genuine error on that line was calling his E a stun and a gap-close; I rewrote it for that reason instead. Two more strings still carry the same E-stun error but sit outside a clean length-band rewrite: full 'mid' ('Bait his E hand-of-the-god — if he whiffs the stun') and content 'late' / wants.foe[2] crediting Stormbringer with a shield (his R grants bonus Health; the shield is on Sky Splitter). Worth a second pass. Also unverified champion-wide: the claim that Neeko's W grants invisibility, repeated in whys[4], mid and wants.you[1] — Riot's W text gives a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, no stealth flag.
